critical_path.rationale: DFS from all 7 nodes found no back-edges (PASS). Longest path computed over blocking edges only (depends-on/blocks; both integrates-with edges excluded). Two roots have no incoming blocking edge: sanctions-screening-provider and kyc-application-service. Both roots reach screening-orchestrator and then fan out to two equally-deep leaves (credential-issuer, settlement-account-provisioner), each chain length 2. This is a genuine 4-way tie at max length 2 — all four are reported, none arbitrarily chosen: [sanctions-screening-provider -> screening-orchestrator -> credential-issuer], [sanctions-screening-provider -> screening-orchestrator -> settlement-account-provisioner], [kyc-application-service -> screening-orchestrator -> credential-issuer], [kyc-application-service -> screening-orchestrator -> settlement-account-provisioner]. The 'nodes' field above holds the first-listed tied chain for schema compatibility; the full tie set is in this rationale and in the .mmd's four %% CRITICAL PATH comments.
